<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4H1Mzs/wbwriter/main/Assets/logo-mark-1024.png" width="72" align="right" alt="WBWriter">

### Fixes

- **Messages and the status line no longer overlap.** When a web control message and the status line don't both fit below the board, the status line steps aside until the message is removed.
- **Web control without a PIN** no longer shows the PIN box on the phone page.
- **Updates are found right away.** The update check always asks GitHub for the latest release instead of reusing a cached answer.

### Download

WBWriter 1.1.1 or later offers this update by itself at launch. Otherwise download **`WBWriter-1.3.3.dmg`** (macOS 13+, Apple Silicon and Intel, signed and notarized), open it and drag WBWriter into Applications.

New: the [Quick start](https://wbwriter.app/docs/quick-start) and [FAQ](https://wbwriter.app/docs/faq) are now on the website, with screenshots.
